protocol.label_contract: Confident direct labels ending in 11; specified ghosts order 2/4/6; generic order 0 separate; direct-ambiguous order 3, groups, negative/uncertain, background, noise, ignore and invalid labels excluded.
protocol.adaptation_limits: Public dataset uses 2D XYZ, fixed zero ego velocity and no SNR gate, ego fit, tracker or accumulation. Amplitude is not SNR. Virtual recordings are constructed overlays.
protocol.sampling_limits: Detection-weighted descriptive rates; correlated frames/points; selected short/small recordings are not representative of the full release or UMRR hardware.
